name: lute-subgraph
description: Real Graph-protocol subgraph indexing ERC-4626 Deposit/Withdraw for the Steakhouse USDC vault on Base. Ships an honest mapping and a bugged mapping (planted entity-id bug) so the unchanged Lute verifier can be run against a real Graph Node.

scripts.build:honest: graph codegen subgraph.honest.yaml && graph build subgraph.honest.yaml
scripts.build:bugged: graph codegen subgraph.bugged.yaml && graph build subgraph.bugged.yaml
scripts.deploy:honest: graph deploy --node http://localhost:8020 --ipfs http://localhost:5001 --version-label v0.0.1 lute/steak-honest subgraph.honest.yaml
scripts.deploy:bugged: graph deploy --node http://localhost:8020 --ipfs http://localhost:5001 --version-label v0.0.1 lute/steak-bugged subgraph.bugged.yaml
